title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛省San Enrique市镇的农业学院更名为San Enrique理工学院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the San Enrique Agricultural College in the Municipality of San Enrique, Province of Iloilo, to San Enrique Polytechnic College
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the San Enrique Agricultural College in the Municipality of San Enrique, Province of Iloilo, to San Enrique Polytechnic College

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1990/ra_6944_1990.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In keeping with its sound operations, the name of the San Enrique Agricultural College is hereby changed into a polytechnic college to be known as the San Enrique Polytechnic College.

The funds required for the implementation of this Act shall be charged to the budget for the SY 1988-1989 of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports allocated for San Enrique Agricultural College.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
